title_original: Gheist: Attempted Scaled Abuse of Stolen GitHub Tokens Stumbles
description: An automated campaign is planting secret-dumping workflows in every repository that stolen GitHub tokens can reach. It uses no C2 server, is actively evolving, and has been significantly disrupted by recent GitHub security improvements.

title_original: Microsoft 365 Token-Replay Attacks Compromise 97 Accounts at 79 Organizations

title_original: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
description:
An automated campaign is using stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that print a repository's secrets into its GitHub Actions logs, which the attackers then download before deleting the runs. title_original: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
description:
A malicious instruction file sitting in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make their AI coding agent install a known-malicious npm package, security firm Forever Security said in a report published last week.
